mode: rule
tproxy-port: 7894
ipv6: false
log-level: error
allow-lan: false
unified-delay: true
tcp-concurrent: true
external-controller: 127.0.0.1:9090
external-ui: ./ui
external-ui-url: 'https://github.com/Zephyruso/zashboard/releases/latest/download/dist-no-fonts.zip'

dns:
  enable: true
  cache-algorithm: arc
  prefer-h3: false
  listen: 0.0.0.0:7874
  ipv6: false
  default-nameserver:
    - 77.88.8.8
    - 9.9.9.9
  enhanced-mode: redir-host
  respect-rules: true
  nameserver-policy:
    "+.ru": https://77.88.8.8/dns-query
    "+.рф": https://77.88.8.8/dns-query
    "+.su": https://77.88.8.8/dns-query
    "+.lan": https://77.88.8.8/dns-query
    "+.local": https://77.88.8.8/dns-query
  nameserver:
    - https://9.9.9.9/dns-query
    - https://1.1.1.1/dns-query
  fallback:
    - https://8.8.8.8/dns-query
  proxy-server-nameserver:
    - https://9.9.9.9/dns-query
    - https://1.1.1.1/dns-query   
  direct-nameserver:
    - https://77.88.8.8/dns-query

profile:
  store-selected: true
  store-fake-ip: false

routing-mark: 2

sniffer:
  enable: true
  force-dns-mapping: true
  parse-pure-ip: true
  override-destination: false
  sniff:
    HTTP:
      ports: [80, 8080-8880]
      override-destination: true
    TLS:
      ports: [443, 8443]
  skip-domain:
    - Mijia Cloud
    - +.lan
    - +.local
    - +.push.apple.com
    - +.apple.com
    - +.openwrt.org

  igareckbl:
    type: http
    url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/igareck/vpn-configs-for-russia/refs/heads/main/BLACK_VLESS_RUS.txt"
    path: ./proxy_providers/provider1.yaml
    interval: 3600
    proxy: Amnezia
    health-check:
      enable: true
      url: https://www.gstatic.com/generate_204
      interval: 300
      timeout: 5000
      lazy: true
      expected-status: 204

  openproxy:
    type: http
    url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/roosterkid/openproxylist/refs/heads/main/V2RAY_RAW.txt"
    path: ./proxy_providers/provider2.yaml
    interval: 3600
    proxy: Amnezia

      interval: 300
      timeout: 5000
      lazy: true
      expected-status: 204

  zieng:
    type: http
    url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zieng2/wl/refs/heads/main/vless_lite.txt"
    path: ./proxy_providers/provider3.yaml
    interval: 3600
    proxy: Amnezia
    health-check:
      enable: true
      url: https://www.gstatic.com/generate_204
      interval: 300
      timeout: 5000
      lazy: true
      expected-status: 204

proxy-groups:

  - name: Amnezia
    type: select
    proxies:
      - Awg1
      - Awg2
      - Awg3
    icon: https://www.vectorlogo.zone/logos/cloudflare/cloudflare-icon.svg

  - name: Masque
    type: url-test
    url: 'https://cp.cloudflare.com/generate_204'
    interval: 30
    tolerance: 100
    proxies:
      - "Masque1"
      - "Masque2"
    icon: https://www.vectorlogo.zone/logos/cloudflare/cloudflare-icon.svg

  - name: YouTube
    type: select
    proxies:
      - Amnezia
      - Masque
    url: 'https://cp.cloudflare.com/generate_204'
    interval: 300
    icon: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Koolson/Qure@master/IconSet/Color/YouTube.png

  - name: WarpInWarp
    type: url-test
    url: "https://cp.cloudflare.com/generate_204"
    interval: 600
    tolerance: 20
    proxies:
      - WiW1
      - WiW2
      - WiW3
    icon: https://www.vectorlogo.zone/logos/cloudflare/cloudflare-icon.svg

  - name: Gemini
    type: url-test
    url: 'https://www.gstatic.com/generate_204'
    interval: 30
    tolerance: 100
    include-all-providers: true
    filter: "🇫🇮|🇫🇷|🇱🇻|🇳🇱|🇸🇪|🇺🇸"
    exclude-filter: "Anycast-IP|Unknown"
    icon: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Koolson/Qure@master/IconSet/Color/AI.png

  - name: Socks
    type: url-test
    url: 'https://www.gstatic.com/generate_204'
    interval: 30
    tolerance: 100
    include-all-providers: true
    exclude-filter: "Anycast-IP|Unknown|Russia|Россия|Belarus|🇧🇾|🇫🇮|🇫🇷|🇱🇻|🇳🇱|🇷🇺|🇸🇪|🇺🇸"
    icon: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Koolson/Qure@master/IconSet/Color/Server.png

  - name: Proxy
    type: load-balance
    proxies:
      - Gemini
      - Socks
    url: 'https://www.gstatic.com/generate_204'
    interval: 300
    strategy: round-robin
    icon: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Koolson/Qure@master/IconSet/Color/Hijacking.png

  - name: NoVPN
    type: select
    proxies:
      - DIRECT
    icon: https://uxwing.com/wp-content/themes/uxwing/download/computers-mobile-hardware/ethernet-port-icon.svg

  - name: Aut
    type: select
    proxies:
      - WarpInWarp
      - Proxy
      - Amnezia
      - NoVPN
    icon: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kiri11uk/Clash-rule/refs/heads/main/ass.png

rules:

  - RULE-SET,private-ips,NoVPN,no-resolve
  - RULE-SET,private-domains,NoVPN

  - AND,((NETWORK,UDP),(DST-PORT,443),(RULE-SET,youtube)),REJECT
  - AND,((NETWORK,UDP),(DST-PORT,443),(RULE-SET,instagram)),REJECT
  - AND,((NETWORK,UDP),(DST-PORT,443),(RULE-SET,twitter)),REJECT

  - RULE-SET,category-ads,REJECT-DROP
  - RULE-SET,win-spy,REJECT-DROP

  - RULE-SET,xiaomi,NoVPN
  - RULE-SET,github,NoVPN
  - RULE-SET,yandex,NoVPN
  - RULE-SET,twitch,NoVPN
  - RULE-SET,microsoft,NoVPN
  - RULE-SET,pinterest,NoVPN
  - RULE-SET,category-ru,NoVPN
  - RULE-SET,whitelist,NoVPN
  - RULE-SET,torrent-domains,NoVPN
  - RULE-SET,torrent-clients,NoVPN
  - RULE-SET,ru-apps,NoVPN
  - RULE-SET,direct-ips,NoVPN

  - RULE-SET,epicgames,Proxy
  - RULE-SET,origin,Proxy
  - RULE-SET,riot,Proxy
  - RULE-SET,steam,Proxy
  - RULE-SET,faceit,Proxy
  - RULE-SET,games,Proxy

  - RULE-SET,youtube,YouTube
  - RULE-SET,google-play,Proxy
  - RULE-SET,twitch-ads,Proxy

  - RULE-SET,telegram,Proxy,no-resolve
  - RULE-SET,telegram-ip,Proxy,no-resolve
  - RULE-SET,twitter,Proxy
  - RULE-SET,instagram,Proxy
  - RULE-SET,facebook,Proxy
  - RULE-SET,whatsapp,Proxy
  - RULE-SET,notion,Proxy
  - RULE-SET,cloudflare,Proxy

  - RULE-SET,gemini,Gemini
  - RULE-SET,openai,Gemini
  - RULE-SET,claude,Gemini

  - MATCH,Aut
